driverRegime.method: daily % change of each asset regressed on the daily change in the US 2-year and 10-year yields (basis points) and on the daily % change in WTI; a driver is dominant when |corr| >= 0.4

dataNotes: Run timing: this cycle ran the morning of 7 October 2026 after the GitHub Actions pre-open fetch job drafted contracts/*.2026-10-06.json from Tuesday 6 October's close. Every figure used is dated at or before the 2026-10-06 close; news-log entries dated 7 October (futures down, oil above $101, gold slide, FOMC minutes preview) were deliberately not used.

Bonds, dollar and IWM sigma are not auto-fetched and were carried stale: bonds 15 (TLT 30-day implied volatility, 25 September), dollar 4.72 (EUR/USD 1-month implied volatility, 21 September), IWM 19.97 (RVX, 23 September). No newer prints were obtainable.

Source notes: the news log gives cash S&P 500 7,840.02 (+0.85%), Nasdaq Composite 27,691.09 and 10-year yield about 5.26% on 6 October; the drafted ES=F/NQ=F/RTY=F/GC=F/ZN=F/DX-Y.NYB closes are used for all numbers, and RTY=F fell 0.81% even though the log describes a broad risk-on close.

No 6 October high-yield OAS, MOVE, breadth counts, positioning print, seasonal statistic or macro data release result was obtainable; credit, breadth, positioning, volatility, calendar and seasonality votes are neutral except where a dated fact (record megacap concentration) is cited. AAII (32.7/19.2/48.1) is the week to 23 September, the newest obtainable.

Fed odds: the October hike probability of about 16% (from 64% a week earlier) and +29K September payrolls are from the 2 October news-log entries, repeated in the 6 October pre-market entry as reduced hike expectations. FOMC minutes are due Wednesday 7 October per the log.

News-log entries for 2026-10-06 (six entries: futures up/yields ease, oil slide, Option Care deal, index close, Skydance-WBD close, Alphabet-Constellation PPA) were already in data/news_log.json and matched the Artifact database; no merge was needed. No hand-entered issue entries were dated 6 October.
